\section[(dialogue)]{The house and things you use — a first pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R138-first-pass-the-house-and-things-you-use}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a carrot and a cauliflower.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a lock, a pillow, a blanket, a curtain, a bucket
  \item a hammer, a nail, scissors, thread, a comb
  \item a towel, a broom, a box, a bag, a candle
  \item matches, a small bowl, a knife, a fan, a watch
  \item glasses, an umbrella, a wallet, a bed frame, bedding
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A lock? (\textbf{\hi{ताला}}, \emph{tālā}.) A pillow? (\textbf{\hi{तकिया}}, \emph{takiyā}.) A blanket? (\textbf{\hi{कंबल}}, \emph{kambal}.) A curtain? (\textbf{\hi{परदा}}, \emph{pardā}.) A bucket? (\textbf{\hi{बाल्टी}}, \emph{bālṭī}.) A hammer? (\textbf{\hi{हथौड़ा}}, \emph{hathauṛā}.) A nail? (\textbf{\hi{कील}}, \emph{kīl}.) Scissors? (\textbf{\hi{कैंची}}, \emph{kaĩcī}.) Thread? (\textbf{\hi{धागा}}, \emph{dhāgā}.) A comb? (\textbf{\hi{कंघी}}, \emph{kaṅghī}.) A towel? (\textbf{\hi{तौलिया}}, \emph{tauliyā}.) A broom? (\textbf{\hi{झाड़ू}}, \emph{jhāṛū}.) A box? (\textbf{\hi{डिब्बा}}, \emph{ḍibbā}.) A bag? (\textbf{\hi{थैला}}, \emph{thailā}.) A candle? (\textbf{\hi{मोमबत्ती}}, \emph{mombattī}.) Matches? (\textbf{\hi{माचिस}}, \emph{māchis}.) A small bowl? (\textbf{\hi{कटोरी}}, \emph{kaṭorī}.) A knife? (\textbf{\hi{छुरी}}, \emph{churī}.) A fan? (\textbf{\hi{पंखा}}, \emph{pankhā}.) A watch? (\textbf{\hi{घड़ी}}, \emph{ghaṛī}.) Glasses? (\textbf{\hi{चश्मा}}, \emph{caśmā}.) An umbrella? (\textbf{\hi{छाता}}, \emph{chātā}.) A wallet? (\textbf{\hi{बटुआ}}, \emph{baṭuā}.) A bed frame? (\textbf{\hi{पलंग}}, \emph{palaṅg}.) Bedding? (\textbf{\hi{लहसुन}}, \emph{lahsun}.) Ginger? (\textbf{\hi{अदरक}}, \emph{adrak}.) A tomato? (\textbf{\hi{टमाटर}}, \emph{ṭamāṭar}.) A carrot? (\textbf{\hi{गाजर}}, \emph{gājar}.) A cauliflower?
